legal.title: Consent required for non-essential cookies
legal.summary: Directive 2002/58/EC requires prior consent before storing or reading non-essential trackers on a user's device (transposed in France by Art. 82 of the Loi Informatique et Libertés).

legal.title: Refusing cookies must be as easy as accepting them
legal.summary: The CNIL guidelines and recommendation on cookies require that refusing be as simple as accepting. In January 2022 the CNIL fined Google €150M and Facebook €60M because refusing took more clicks than accepting.

legal.title: Withdrawing consent must be as easy as giving it
legal.summary: Regulation (EU) 2016/679 requires that it be as easy to withdraw consent as to give it.

legal.title: Ban on deceptive interface design by online platforms
legal.summary: Regulation (EU) 2022/2065 forbids online platforms from designing interfaces that deceive or manipulate users, including giving more prominence to certain choices, repeatedly requesting a choice already made, and making termination harder than subscribing.
